entries.basis: Current AppOperationSteps renders native ordered items with translated pending/in-progress/completed/error text, a named active progress indicator, distinct non-color state glyphs and no Step1of1 numbering. Existing unit tests verify exact state transitions, empty/SSR, stable list items, completed/error presentation and translated status. The composed host keeps one persistent polite Status; actual DOM messages update on completion/failure/reset while percentage ticks stay quiet. Batch07/batch67 and HB07 retain accepted native keyboard/focus/reflow/theme/density/presentation proof and F-C03/T-C03/V-C03 lineage. This satisfies state-announcement implementation support; it does not substitute DOM evidence for spoken AT.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-M-03 Reconcile AppOperationSteps final acceptance: State announcements, completed/error/active visuals, hide single-step numbering. Link its `F-C03`, `T-C03` and `V-C03` evidence and any unresolved defects.

limits: No new audible/simulator test or claim of spoken announcement timing, silence or duplicate-count conformance. Those operator observations remain under A-X-11. The component is presentation; hosts own milestone messages and real operation state. Existing native evidence keeps its original runtime/source boundaries.
